profile.name: Aarav Sharma
profile.headline:
Building Intelligent Systems
& Digital Experiences.
profile.bio:
Computer Science student passionate about full-stack engineering, distributed systems, and applied machine learning.

I focus on crafting responsive, high-performance web applications with modern architectures like Next.js, React, TypeScript, and SQLite. Active open-source contributor and hackathon finalist driven by building tools that solve real human challenges.

projects.title: CampusFlow — Campus Collaboration
projects.description: A comprehensive campus community platform for event registration, academic resources sharing, and peer mentoring. Built with real-time updates and interactive dashboards.

projects.title: NeuroQuery — AI Document Intelligence
projects.description: High-speed retrieval-augmented generation engine that answers queries over large technical documentation with citations, sub-second latency, and SQLite vector indexing.

projects.title: PulseMetrics — Cloud Performance Tracker
projects.description: Lightweight distributed telemetry dashboard monitoring microservices health, latency histograms, and automated incident alerts with zero-dependency SQLite storage.

education.detail: Focusing on distributed algorithms, database internals, and software engineering. Core coursework in DBMS, OS, Computer Networks, and AI Systems.

experiences.detail: Architected low-latency full-stack features using Next.js, SQLite, and Python FastAPI microservices. Optimized query execution times by 40%.
Contributed performance optimizations, developer tooling improvements, and accessibility enhancements across modern web frameworks.

achievements: Finalist at HackIndia 2025 out of 1,200+ collegiate engineering teams
Published research poster on sub-second local vector search in SQLite
Dean's Honor List for Academic Excellence (Top 5% of department)
